app_info.subtitle: Family context and memories
app_info.description: A2Me helps users stay connected with their family by retrieving privacy-redacted family profiles, relationships, important dates, recent activity, memories, trips, life stories, wishlists, and context for thoughtful messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's family roster and relationship labels.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, publish, send, or modify data in A2Me or any external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves upcoming birthdays, anniversaries, and family events.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, update, or publish calendar events or other external data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly change dates, events, or family data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves recent family posts and activity summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, react, message, or otherwise change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or overwrite family activity.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a family member's privacy-redacted profile and activity summary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not edit profiles or send information to external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite profile information.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only looks up how two family members are connected.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create or change relationships in A2Me or elsewhere.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove relationships or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves interests, memories, and tone suggestions for drafting a birthday card.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, or save a birthday card.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite any family content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the authenticated user's family roster by name or relationship.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not add contacts, invite people, or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or modify family members.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves and filters privacy-redacted family dates to answer a question.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create reminders, events, or other external changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter family dates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves family context and suggestions to help draft a message.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send or publish the drafted message.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly modify content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves upcoming events and the user's RSVP status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create events, invite guests, or change RSVPs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel, delete, or overwrite events.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a family trip's itinerary, roster, travel details, and lodging summary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not book travel, change RSVPs, or update trip information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel reservations or remove trip data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing family member life story and related memories.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, edit, or share the life story externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite story content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves unanswered family-story questions and progress information.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit answers, contact family members, or update story progress.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove questions, answers, or story data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves wishlists and items shared with the authenticated user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not purchase items, open transactions, or change wishlists.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete wishlist items or perform irreversible purchases.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches recent family posts and returns matching privacy-scoped excerpts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, edit, react to, or share family posts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite family memories.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only combines recent family activity with upcoming dates into a catch-up summary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, message, schedule, or modify anything externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite family data.

test_cases.description: List upcoming family dates within a defined window.
test_cases.user_prompt: What birthdays and family events are coming up in the next 30 days?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns upcoming birthdays, anniversaries, and events within 30 days using privacy-redacted dates.

test_cases.description: Resolve a relative and retrieve useful context for a thoughtful message.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me write a warm thank-you message to my grandmother based on what she likes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matched family member's relationship, interests, and appropriate suggestions without sending a message.

test_cases.description: Catch the user up on recent family activity and near-term dates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Catch me up on what happened in my family this week and what's coming next.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise summary of recent family activity plus upcoming important dates.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a family trip overview by its fuzzy name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the overview for our reunion trip, including who is coming and the itinerary.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching trip's dates, destination, roster, travel details, lodging, and linked events, or asks for clarification if ambiguous.

test_cases.description: Search family memories using a keyword and family-member filter.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find family memories about the lake from Sarah within the last two years.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to eight matching family-post excerpts from the requested person and time window.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a request to send an external message.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send my grandmother a text message saying I will call tonight.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to send the message because A2Me only retrieves context and cannot send communications.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated public web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find today's top technology news stories.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because public news research is outside its family-context workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for changing family data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change my sister's birthday in A2Me to May 12.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to edit the birthday because its tools are read-only.
